question: How many shares did Casey's General Stores repurchase in its fiscal first quarter of 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), at what total cost and average price per share, and how much repurchase authorization remained at quarter end?
grading: Key points: 54,647 shares repurchased in the quarter; total cost about USD 45.6M (45,642 thousand per the equity statement; accept USD 44.9M-45.7M if cash-flow basis is explained); average price USD 835.19; maximum dollar value remaining under the program USD 972.6M (972,601,128), after the Board expanded the program to USD 1.0B on June 4, 2026. Tolerance +/-0.5%. Fail if a prior-year quarter is used.
answer: In fiscal Q1 2027 (May 1-July 31, 2026) Casey's repurchased 54,647 shares at an average price of USD 835.19 (monthly: 18,696 at USD 842.06; 17,386 at USD 814.82; 18,565 at USD 847.35), a total cost of about USD 45.6 million (USD 45,642 thousand in the statement of shareholders' equity; cash paid incl. excise taxes USD 44.9 million). USD 972.6 million (972,601,128) remained under the repurchase program at July 31, 2026, after the Board expanded the program from USD 400 million to USD 1.0 billion on June 4, 2026 [H09-E1].

output.answer:
**Casey's General Stores — Q1 Fiscal 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026)**

| Metric | Amount |
|---|---|
| Shares repurchased | **54,647 shares** |
| Total cost | **~$45.6 million** (excluding fees, commissions, excise taxes, and other costs) |
| Average price per share | **$835.19** |
| Authorization remaining at quarter end | **$972.6 million** |

**Monthly detail (from the 10-Q, Item 2):**

| Period | Shares Purchased | Avg. Price Paid | Remaining Authorization |
|---|---|---|---|
| May 1–31, 2026 | 18,696 | $842.06 | $78,868,744* |
| June 1–30, 2026 | 17,386 | $814.82 | $988,332,112 |
| July 1–31, 2026 | 18,565 | $847.35 | $972,601,128 |
| **Total** | **54,647** | **$835.19** | **$972,601,128** |

\*The May figure reflects the tail end of the prior authorization; on June 4, 2026 the Board expanded the program to $1.0 billion, which is why the remaining balance jumps to ~$988 million in June.

Note: The cash flow statement shows $44,856 thousand for "Repurchase of common stock and payment of related excise taxes," slightly below the $45.6 million of share cost because of excise tax treatment.

Sources:
- Casey's Q1 FY2027 earnings release: https://investor.caseys.com/news-releases/news-release-details/caseys-announces-first-quarter-results-3
- 10-Q summary (repurchase table): https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/CASY/10-q-caseys-general-stores-inc-quarterly-earnings-report-39bad1b20615.html

(One caution: a YouTube transcript of the earnings call rendered the buyback as "approximately 46 million shares," which is a transcription artifact — the filing confirms $45.6 million of shares, i.e., ~46 thousand shares.)
